title: Estimated Patient Pay During a Pending Medical Assistance Application
content:
**Rule.** While the application is pending, and while a denial is under a fair hearing, the resident pays an estimated patient pay each month. Patient pay is billed only while the case is pending, eligible or under a fair hearing. Estimated or actual patient pay for a month is due on the due day of that month. No late charge is ever assessed on patient pay.

**The estimate formula.** The clause as first worked — the estimate is "gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less health insurance premiums the resident pays, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance on the worksheet when the tier applies it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent" — is no longer in force as an unqualified rule. In its current form: for an advance toward a coming pending month, and only for such an advance, the estimated patient pay is the base estimate figure as the rule for such advances changes it; every estimate the business office bills remains under the base rule: gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less health insurance premiums the resident pays, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance on the worksheet when the tier applies it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage the personal needs allowance, the protected VA pension amount and which allowance each tier deducts are the tier settings of the product; the income, premiums and allowance amounts are the figures on the case.

**When an estimate may be billed.** The case status on the system record decides it:

| Case status | Patient pay may be billed |
|---|---|
| pending | yes |
| eligible | yes |
| under a fair hearing | yes |
| application in preparation, denied, closed | no |

**Hypothetical billed estimate.** A case on the Community Spouse Allowance tier records gross monthly income of 2,412.66 dollars, health insurance premiums of 248.60 dollars and a community spouse allowance of 611.25 dollars. The estimate is 2,412.66 less 45.00, less 248.60, less 611.25, which is 1,507.81 dollars. Had the deductions exceeded the income, the estimate would be zero. The estimate is due on the due day of its service month and never carries a late charge.

superseded_clauses: gross monthly income less the personal needs allowance, less health insurance premiums the resident pays, less the protected VA pension amount for the VA tier, and less the community spouse, dependent family or home maintenance allowance on the worksheet when the tier applies it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.
